pages.title: ORSA Fabricator
pages.text: Six inputs, one output. It prints parts from blueprints this world has archived.

pages.title: Building
pages.text: Crafted from iron, copper, a crafting table, an $(l:power/induction_furnace)Induction Furnace$(/l) and a redstone block. Link it to your grid with the $(l:power/binder)Conduit Binder$(/l).

pages.title: Printing
pages.text: A job draws 5 to 60 kW, depending on the part, and sheds a quarter of that as room heat.$(br2)Losing power pauses the job. Ingredients are spent only when it finishes. Hoppers can feed it.

pages.title: What It Prints
pages.text: $(li)Magnet Coils, the First Wall, Lithium Blankets, the High-Temperature Radiator and the Isotope Column$(li)The AMR-1 "Icarus" core parts$(li)The Rocket Hull and Rocket Engine, from the Martian Command blueprint
